statement: Per issuer and per taxpayer, eligible § 1202 gain for a taxable year is capped at the greater of (A) $10,000,000 — $15,000,000, inflation-adjusted after 2026, for stock acquired after the applicable date (July 4, 2025) — reduced by aggregate eligible gain taken into account in prior taxable years for dispositions of that issuer's stock, or (B) 10 times the aggregate adjusted bases of qualified small business stock issued by the corporation and disposed of by the taxpayer during the taxable year (26 U.S.C. § 1202(b)(1)).
caveat: Married-filing-separately halves the dollar cap; basis for the 10x test is determined with § 1202(i) rules (contributed property at FMV); the post-2025 $15,000,000 cap interacts with pre-applicable-date dispositions in the same year. Stacking/packing strategies are planning questions far outside this repo. Verify current law.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (business-logic tax-mechanics lane 2026-10-01); independent domain expert review pending
